title: UI anchors behave reversed horizontally during runtime
body:
### Tested versions
v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - macOS Tahoe (26.4.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M2 (Apple8) - Apple M2 (8 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

I am experiencing an issue where UI anchors behave incorrectly on the horizontal axis during runtime.
When I set a Control node (e.g. Label) to Top Left, it appears on the right side of the screen when running the game. Similarly, setting it to the right places it on the left. The vertical axis (top/bottom) works correctly. it's not the scale or the parent it happen to me in all off my projects.It only happens during runtime, not in the editor and it isn't the force left to right setting.

### Steps to reproduce

create a new empty Godot project, add a CanvasLayer with a Control node and a Label as a child, set the Label’s layout to “Top Left”, and run the scene. The expected result is that the Label appears in the top-left corner of the screen, but instead it appears in the top-right corner, as if the horizontal axis is reversed. The issue happens in all new projects, only during runtime (not in the editor), with no scripts, no containers, and no scale or anchor modifications.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The issue is reproducible in a brand new empty project without any additional files or assets. It occurs immediately after creating a scene with CanvasLayer → Control → Label, applying “Top Left” layout, and running the scene. No custom scripts, external resources, or project-specific configuration are required.
